Package com.github.query4j.optimizer

Class OptimizerConfig

java.lang.Object
com.github.query4j.optimizer.OptimizerConfig
public final class OptimizerConfig extends Object
Immutable configuration for QueryOptimizer behavior and analysis parameters. Provides control over optimization strategies, thresholds, and feature enablement.
Since:
1.0.0

    • getIndexSelectivityThreshold

      public double getIndexSelectivityThreshold()
      Minimum selectivity threshold for index suggestions (0.0 to 1.0). Lower values will suggest indexes for more selective predicates.

    • getPredicateReorderingThreshold

      public double getPredicateReorderingThreshold()
      Minimum improvement threshold for predicate reordering suggestions (0.0 to 1.0). Higher values require more significant improvements to suggest reordering.

    • getJoinReorderingThreshold

      public double getJoinReorderingThreshold()
      Minimum cardinality reduction threshold for join reordering (0.0 to 1.0). Higher values require more significant improvements to suggest reordering.

    • getMaxAnalysisTimeMs

      public long getMaxAnalysisTimeMs()
      Maximum analysis time in milliseconds before timeout. Zero or negative values disable timeout.
